name: const-language
description: Plain prose in governed documents, checked by Vale after every write and in a scan: a Flesch–Kincaid grade ceiling, a words-per-sentence limit, idioms and formal phrases plain language avoids, formal words with a plain replacement, passive voice reported — every threshold and level a dial, a departure declared in the dials file and never marked in the document. Plus a skill that applies the rules while writing and reads a finding.
